flaggedResidues.resolved: 2026-09-01: buildCharacter now emits Character.ancestryHeritageChoices (the carrier — every ancestry/heritage own-choice answer, all 12 flags, keyed exactly as featChoices keys them; every persistence path was verified whole-object JSON so it survives roster save, .codex export, campaign sync and GM edit). deriveBuildFromCharacter copies it back validated against the record's options, and for pre-carrier saves falls back to the traces on the character: size (cross-checked against ancestryHp/hpBySize) for bodySize, ancestryHp === alternateAttributes.hp for the Mightyfall package. The abilities reconstruction now also passes the recovered heritage answer to heritageAdjustedAncestryAttributes and takes ancestry boost slots from the ADJUSTED boosts, so a kaiju kobold's scores rebuild against the package's fixed str/cha + int flaw rather than the normal kobold arrays. Guard: 6 round-trip tests in test/reverse-build.test.ts ('ancestry/heritage own-choice answers'). magiphage/exemplar answers on pre-carrier saves are genuinely unrecoverable (no trace on the Character) — the carrier exists so no new save loses them.
